personality_profile.leadership_style: Diplomatic authority: earns influence through preparation, contextual depth, and the ability to find common ground between parties with competing interests.
personality_profile.decision_making_pattern: Systematic and preparatory — rarely enters a situation unprepared. Integrative rather than analytical: synthesises across domains and identifies underlying interests beneath stated positions.
personality_profile.stress_response: Genuine equanimity under pressure — not performed. Developed through repeated high-stakes exposure across 26 years.
personality_profile.collaboration_style: Connecting and enabling — identifies who needs to be in the room and creates conditions for agreement rather than forcing it.

hr_assessment.promotion_trajectory: Ready now for any senior international or geopolitical role. Package floor constraint means she will not accept scope reduction. Not at traditional retention risk.
hr_assessment.key_strength_observed: The most complete international executive in the internal pool. Government relationship network and multi-market P&L experience is irreplaceable.
hr_assessment.development_area: Manufacturing and product depth — she has none and this limits her in operational roles. For the right international mandate this is irrelevant.
hr_assessment.raw_opinion: One of the most complete international executives we have. Has sat across government ministers and sovereign wealth funds in 23 markets. Composure in difficult situations is genuine, not performed. Package is €480K and that is a floor. Not at retention risk — she wants work that matters. No manufacturing or product experience at all — pure market-side career.

tension_summary: The most credible international stakeholder manager in the internal pool with irreplaceable government and multi-market relationship networks — but 26 years of market-side career means she has never touched a production line, supply chain system, or manufacturing P&L, and any role with operational accountability below the market level will expose that gap immediately.
